_source: VFA Recreational Fishing Guide 2026, checked 18 Oct 2026. Victorian marine and estuary limits only. Other states differ.

australian-salmon.name: Australian salmon
australian-salmon.gear: 10–12 ft surf rod, 4000–6000 reel, 6–8 kg line. Paternoster with a popper, or a 40–60 g metal slug.
australian-salmon.bait: Pilchard, bluebait, surf poppers, metal slugs

tailor.name: Tailor
tailor.gear: Surf or estuary spin outfit. Use 15 kg leader or a short wire trace. They bite through light line.
tailor.bait: Whole pilchard on ganged hooks, metal slugs

gummy-shark.name: Gummy shark
gummy-shark.gear: Heavy surf rod, 10–15 kg line, running sinker rig with 6/0 circle hook. Fish after dark.

black-bream.name: Black bream
black-bream.gear: 1–4 kg spin outfit, 2500 reel, 6–8 lb fluorocarbon leader, size 4–1 hook, light running sinker.
black-bream.bait: Sandworm, prawn, crab, small soft plastics and blades

dusky-flathead.name: Dusky flathead
dusky-flathead.gear: 2–4 kg spin outfit, 10–12 lb leader. 3–4 inch soft plastic on a 1/8–1/4 oz jighead, kept on the bottom.

estuary-perch.name: Estuary perch
estuary-perch.gear: Light spin outfit, 6–8 lb leader. Small hardbodies, surface lures at dusk.
estuary-perch.bait: Small hardbodies, shrimp, live baits near snags

luderick.name: Luderick
luderick.gear: Long float rod, small float, size 10–8 hook, light leader.

yellow-eye-mullet.name: Yellow-eye mullet
yellow-eye-mullet.gear: Light rod, small float, size 12–10 hook.
yellow-eye-mullet.bait: Bread, dough, small pieces of prawn

king-george-whiting.name: King George whiting
king-george-whiting.gear: Light spin rod, 2–4 kg line, running sinker to a long trace with a size 6–4 long-shank hook. Berley helps.
king-george-whiting.bait: Pipis, mussel, squid strips, bass yabbies

snapper.name: Snapper
snapper.gear: Medium boat rod, 6–10 kg line, paternoster or running sinker with 4/0–6/0 circle hooks. Fish reef edges and drop-offs.
snapper.bait: Pilchards, squid, fresh fish fillets, soft plastics

squid.name: Squid (calamari)
squid.gear: Light spin rod with a 2.5–3.0 size squid jig. Cast, let it sink, then slow lifts and pauses. Best over weed and around lights.
squid.bait: Prawn-style squid jigs, baited jigs with whitebait

sand-whiting.name: Sand whiting
sand-whiting.gear: Light rod, 2–4 kg line, small running sinker to the hook, size 6–4 long-shank. Fish the shallows on a rising tide.
sand-whiting.bait: Beach worms, yabbies, pipis, small surface poppers

yellowfin-bream.name: Yellowfin bream
yellowfin-bream.gear: 1–4 kg spin outfit, 6–8 lb fluorocarbon leader, light running sinker and size 4–1 hook. Fish structure and edges.
yellowfin-bream.bait: Prawns, yabbies, mullet strips, small soft plastics

mulloway.name: Mulloway (jewfish)
mulloway.gear: Heavy surf or estuary rod, 10–15 kg line, running sinker with 6/0–8/0 hooks. Best at night on the tide change.
mulloway.bait: Live mullet, fresh squid, beach worms, large soft plastics

trevally.name: Trevally
trevally.gear: Medium spin outfit, 4–8 kg line. Fast-retrieved metal slugs or soft plastics. They pull hard, so check your drag.

mangrove-jack.name: Mangrove jack
mangrove-jack.gear: Stout baitcaster or spin rod, 8–10 kg braid, 30–40 lb leader. Fish tight to snags and lock up the drag.
mangrove-jack.bait: Live baits, fresh fish strips, hardbody lures, soft plastics

barramundi.name: Barramundi
barramundi.gear: Baitcaster or spin outfit, 10–15 kg braid, 40–60 lb leader. Fish snags, drains and creek mouths on the run-out.
barramundi.bait: Live mullet or prawns, hardbody lures, soft vibes

australian-herring.name: Australian herring (tommy ruff)
australian-herring.gear: Light spin rod, 2–4 kg line, float or small running sinker with a size 10–8 hook. Berley brings schools in.
australian-herring.bait: Maggots, prawn pieces, small metal lures, gents

sand-flathead.name: Sand flathead
sand-flathead.gear: Light to medium outfit, paternoster rig with size 1–1/0 hooks, fished on the bottom over sand.
sand-flathead.bait: Squid strips, pilchard pieces, soft plastics

murray-cod.name: Murray cod
murray-cod.gear: Heavy baitcaster, 15–25 kg braid or mono, 60–80 lb leader. Fish deep holes and big timber. Seasonal closure applies in spring.
murray-cod.bait: Large spinnerbaits, deep divers, cheese, yabbies, bardi grubs

golden-perch.name: Golden perch (yellowbelly)
golden-perch.gear: Light to medium outfit, 4–6 kg line. Fish timber and rock bars in warmer months.
golden-perch.bait: Shrimp, yabbies, worms, small spinnerbaits and lipless lures

redfin.name: Redfin (English perch)
redfin.gear: Light spin outfit, 2–4 kg line. Fish weed edges and timber. In many states you must not release redfin alive.
redfin.bait: Worms, small soft plastics, spinners, small hardbodies

trout.name: Trout
trout.gear: Light spin or fly outfit, 2–3 kg line. Fish early and late around inflows and drop-offs.
trout.bait: Small spinners, soft plastics, mudeyes, scrub worms, flies
